title: Fixtures and fittings — Sturij
description: Rails, pull-outs, pocket doors, concealed hinges and built-in lighting: the fittings behind the pieces you use, from Häfele and Sugatsune.

source.part: Part 3 — Fixtures and fittings (Häfele, Sugatsune, built-in lighting)

parts.heading: The details are where a room starts to feel finished.

standfirst.text: Rails that don't sag. Lighting that's built in, not stuck on. A door that disappears into the wall. These are the fittings behind the pieces you'll actually use, and we specify them from two makers who do this and nothing else.

lines.text: A family firm from Nagold that has made furniture fittings since 1923, and the maker we turn to for the everyday things a wardrobe or media wall needs: hanging rails, wirework and pull-outs, connectors, and the integrated LED lighting we build into shelves and hanging spaces.
At Atelier, Häfele's solid-metal handles and fittings are the ones you can feel the weight of.

Where a room needs a fitting that does something unusual — a heavy lift-up door that opens and holds itself, a pocket door that slides away and closes softly, a concealed hinge that lets a door vanish into panelling — we specify Sugatsune. They make the pieces most people never see and everyone notices.
Shelf, rail and drawer lighting is planned on the drawing, wired inside the carcass on a low-voltage system, and switched where you'd expect. It's part of the furniture, not an afterthought.
If there's a fitting you've seen in a hotel or a showroom and wondered how it works, ask at the design visit. It's usually one of these two.

faq.q: Can you build lighting into the furniture?

a.text: Yes. Shelf, rail and drawer lighting is planned on your drawing and built into the carcass — warm or cool, switched or sensor-triggered.

faq.q: Can a door slide away into the cabinet?

a.text: Yes — a pocket door slides in beside the carcass so the opening is fully clear, and closes softly. We use Sugatsune's systems for these.

faq.q: Can a door be hidden in the panelling?

a.text: Yes. A concealed hinge lets a door sit flush in a run of panelling with no visible hardware, adjustable after fitting. Sugatsune make the ones we trust for it.
Not the ones we fit. Wardrobe rails are specified for the span and the load — a long run gets a centre support or a stronger section, not a hope.
Yes — from the range on this site, in the finishes shown.
At Atelier the handles and fittings are Häfele's solid-metal pieces.

faq.q: Do the fittings match the finish?

a.text: Handles, rails and lighting profiles come in finishes that sit with the door decor and each other; we'll show you the combinations with the samples at the visit.
